{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Found {len(qa_orders)} QA orders to remove")

# Remove QA orders from the completed set
final_df = df_completed[~df_completed['revenue_clean'].isin([999999.99])]

# Final population: completed orders, excluding QA orders
print(f"Final number of completed orders (excluding QA): {len(final_df)}")

# Compute average revenue per completed order
avg_revenue = final_df['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output
print(f"Average revenue per completed order: {avg_revenue:.2f}")"}
